title: Inside Out - Key Vocabulary & Transcript Practice
description: Luyện nghe và học từ vựng tiếng Anh qua các phân cảnh và đoạn thoại nổi tiếng trong bộ phim hoạt hình Inside Out (Những Mảnh Ký Ức).
transcript:
We were no longer Marsha. We are the ___shoes___.

Joy: Woah, okay. I have an idea. How about instead we watch a ___nature___ show.

A young deer grazing quietly in the meadow, has no chance against the vicious jaws of a ___grizzly___ bear.

Joy: Disgust, it's fine. It passed the ___five second___ rule.

Disgust: The grape touched the ground. It's ___poison___.

Disgust: You don't know what barely touched the ground? Stray dogs, toenails clipping, ___roadkill___, hippies, dung beetles.

Joy: It's a grape. It's not like we're eating ___broccoli___ or boogers or dog food.

Riley's Dad: The ___investors___ are supposed to show up on Thursday, not today. Stall for me!

Sadness: He doesn't love us anymore. That's sad. I should ___drive___, right?

Riley: Hey, I saw a ___pizza___ place down the street, maybe we should try that.

Anger: Congratulations, San Francisco. You ruined pizza! First the ___Hawaiians___, and now you!

Joy: These are called ___Core___ Memories. Each one came from a super important time in Riley's life.

Joy: Each Core Memory powers a different aspect of Riley's ___personality___.

Joy: ___Goofball___ Island is my personal favorite.

Disgust: Okay, Caution. There is a dangerous ___smell___ people. It's Broccoli!

Joy: Disgust basically keeps Riley from being poisoned, physically and ___socially___.

Riley's Dad: If you don't eat your dinner, you're not getting any ___dessert___.

Anger: He cared very deeply about things getting ___fairer___.

Riley's Dad: Riley, here comes the ___airplane___. Vrooooooom!

Joy: Fear, I need a list of all possible ___negatives___ on the first day at the new school.

Fear: Does anybody know how to spell ___meteor___?

Joy: Disgust, make sure Riley stands out today, but also ___blends___ in.

Joy: And there. Perfect! This is the ___circle___ of sadness. Your job is to make sure all the sadness stays inside of it.

Riley's Mom: Were gonna find out what's happening, but we need support. Signal the ___husband___.

Fear's Dad: Sire, she just rolled her ___eyes___ at us.

Anger's Dad: Take it to ___DEFCON___ 2!

Riley's Dad: That's it! Go to your ___room___!

Fear's Dad: The ___foot___ is down!

Sadness: That's ___long___ term memory! Endless warren of corridors and shelves. I read about it in the ___manuals___.

matchingSynonyms.word: By the skin of our teeth

mcqQuestions.q: What does Anger mean by 'By the skin of our teeth'?
options: They barely succeeded in catching the grape in time.

mcqQuestions.q: What is Disgust emphasizing when she says 'It passed the five-second rule'?
options: Food dropped on the floor is safe if picked up within 5 seconds.
The floor is cleaned every 5 seconds.

mcqQuestions.q: When Dad says 'Stall for me', what is he asking Mom/his coworker to do?
options: Delay the investors until he arrives.

mcqQuestions.q: What does Joy mean by 'These are called Core Memories'?
options: Memories that are boring and forgotten.
Highly significant memories that shape Riley's personality.
Bad memories that need to be deleted.

mcqQuestions.q: What is Disgust's main role when Joy says 'She keeps Riley from being poisoned, physically and socially'?
options: To protect Riley from dangerous food and embarrassing social situations.

mcqQuestions.q: What does Anger mean by 'Congratulation, San Francisco. You ruin pizza!'?
options: He is outraged because they put broccoli on pizza.
He wants to open a pizza shop.
Pizza was invented in San Francisco.

mcqQuestions.q: When Mom says 'Signal the husband', what is her intention?
options: To call him on the phone.
To get Dad to ask Riley what's wrong.
To tell Dad to cook dinner.

mcqQuestions.q: What does Dad's emotion mean by 'Take it to DEFCON 2!'?
options: Escalate the disciplinary response to high alert.

mcqQuestions.q: What does 'Prepare the foot!' mean in Dad's headquarters?
options: Prepare to strictly enforce authority ('put his foot down').

mcqQuestions.q: What does Sadness mean when she says 'I'm positive you will get lost in there'?
options: She is absolutely sure they will lose their way in Long Term Memory.
She wants to play a game.
